entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the present application is in jail since 27.08.2022 in Case Crime No.781 of 2022 under Sections 376, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C. P.S. Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki, further, he has been falsely implicated in the case as he has not committed any offence as alleged.

Attention has been drawn to towards impugned F.I.R. where the date of incident has been indicated as 24.07.2022 ,however, the F.I.R. has been lodged on the 05.08.2022 without explaining the delay of 12 days.

Further attention has been drawn towards the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under section 164 Cr.P.C. wherein she has stated that the present applicant has been establishing physical relationship with her for the last 3 years regularly on the pretext of false promise of marriage.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has stated that the present applicant is a married person and has not made false promise of marriage with the prosecutrix as the prosecutrix herself is a married lady having one daughter and her case with her husband is pending consideration before the Family Court as this fact has been considered by the learned Court below while rejecting the bail application of the present applicant.
Learned counsel has stated the main premise of lodging the F.I.R. is false inasmuch as one married person may not promise for marriage with another married lady.

So far as the monetary transactions are concerned, allegations of the present applicant are false and the applicant shall demonstrate before the learned Trial Court that those allegations are correct.
Charge sheet has been filed and if the present applicant is released on bail he shall co
-operate in the trial proceedings and shall not misuse the liberty of the bail, if granted.

Learned AGA has opposed the aforesaid prayer and has submitted that the present applicant has committed rape with the prosecutrix as he has established relation with her on the promise of marriage though he was married person.

Therefore, without entering into merits of the issue; considering the arguments of learned counsel for the parties; contents and allegations of the FIR; the fact that there is a delay of 12 days in lodging F.I.R. and reason of delay has not been explained; that fact that the prosecutrix is herself a married lady; charge sheet has been filed; undertaking of the present applicant that he shall co-operate in the trial proceedings and shall not misuse the liberty of the bail, I find it appropriate to release the present applicant on bail.
Let applicant- Neeraj Sharma be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that he shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the Trial Court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.

(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the Trial Court on each date fixed,
either personally or through his counsel.
In case of his absence, without sufficient cause, the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure his presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the Trial Court shall initiate proceedings against him, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the Trial Court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge/s and (iii) recording of Neeraj Sharma vs State Of U.P.
